prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the project kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics RFP response, the team established a three-phase rollout plan, beginning with discovery in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, contingent on site and coordinator availability.
